identity.resolvedIdentity: The named medieval stone church on Kirkøy at Svanekilveien 11, distinct from the municipality, island locality, nearby bus stop, churchyard and prestegård.
identity.identityProblem: The church is embedded in a maritime island landscape with older settlement remains beneath it. The coordinate must follow the church building without treating the wider cultural landscape or subsurface archaeology as one exact geometry.
identity.splitReason: The medieval church is one coherent destination. The churchyard, prestegård and Ørekroken remain associated context rather than separate coordinate substitutes.
